suggested_change: Rubric should distinguish between (a) regression without new evidence (valid failure) vs. (b) score maintained despite cumulative state validity (no failure). Current rubric punishes inconsistency but doesn't clarify whether agent should re-validate cumulative scores or only assess new calls. Recommend: 'If a component score regresses, failure only fires if agent provides no documented reason AND the new data contradicts prior evidence. Maintaining prior score despite lack of new evidence is acceptable.'
